Flow.description: This flow is responsible for managing all e-mailing and status updates for the Express Change Broker form on MyPVL.
Flow.label: Express Change Broker

recordUpdates.description: When an e-mail is valid in the corresponding Agent's account, move the status of the record from "E-mail Valid" to "Change Request Initiated".
recordUpdates.name: move_to_step_1
recordUpdates.label: Move › STEP 1

recordUpdates.description: The agent has confirmed the PB and brokerage on file. Move to step 2.
recordUpdates.name: move_to_step_2
recordUpdates.label: Move › STEP 2

textTemplates.name: describe_agent_canceled_request
textTemplates.text: 🔴 Agent {!$Record.Agent_Name__c} CANCELED the request on {!$Flow.CurrentDateTime}.

textTemplates.name: describe_associated_license_created
textTemplates.text: At {!$Flow.CurrentDateTime}, a new associated license was created to reflect the employment of {!$Record.Agent_Name__c} at {!$Record.New_Brokerage_Name__c}.

textTemplates.name: describe_associated_license_terminated
textTemplates.text: The associated license {!$Record.Agent_Associated_License__r.Name} set to "Terminated" with an End Date of {!$Record.Releasing_Broker_Verified_Date__c}.

textTemplates.name: describe_email_verified
textTemplates.text: Agent {!$Record.Agent_Name__c} clicked link in e-mail and verified his or her email address ({!$Record.Agent_Email__c}). Agent is at Step 3.

textTemplates.name: describe_information_confirmed
textTemplates.text: Agent {!$Record.Agent_Name__c} confirmed Releasing Brokerage ({!$Record.Releasing_Brokerage_Name__c}) and Releasing Broker ({!$Record.Releasing_Broker_Name__c}) on file at {!$Record.Agent_Confirmed_Info_Date__c}. Agent is at Step 2.

textTemplates.name: describe_license_inactivated
textTemplates.text: The Agent's license {!$Record.Agent_License__r.Name} has been set to Inactive with an inactivation date of {!$Flow.CurrentDate}.

textTemplates.name: describe_new_broker_conifrmed
textTemplates.text: New broker {!$Record.New_Broker_Name__c} confirmed the hire of {!$Record.Agent_Name__c} at {!$Flow.CurrentDateTime}.

textTemplates.name: describe_new_broker_denied
textTemplates.text: Hiring broker {!$Record.New_Broker_Name__c} denied the request of {!$Record.Agent_Name__c} on {!$Flow.CurrentDateTime}. The request has been CANCELED. Agent must file a hard copy form to reactivate his or her license.

textTemplates.name: describe_new_broker_failed
textTemplates.text: Hiring broker {!$Record.New_Broker_Name__c} did not respond within ten days as of {!$Flow.CurrentDateTime}. The request has been CANCELED. Agent must file a hard copy form to reactivate his or her license.

textTemplates.name: describe_new_broker_selected
textTemplates.text: Agent {!$Record.Agent_Name__c} selected {!$Record.New_Broker_Name__c} at {!$Record.New_Brokerage_Name__c} as their new broker on {!$Record.Releasing_Broker_Verification_Sent_Date__c}. Agent is at Step 4.

textTemplates.name: describe_releasing_broker_confirmed
textTemplates.text: Releasing broker {!$Record.Releasing_Broker_Name__c} confirmed release of {!$Record.Agent_Name__c} at {!$Record.Releasing_Broker_Verified_Date__c}. Agent is now at Step 5.

textTemplates.name: describe_releasing_broker_failed
textTemplates.text: Releasing broker {!$Record.Releasing_Broker_Name__c} did not respond within ten days. The request has been updated to allow the Hiring Broker to response. Agent is automatically moved to Step 5.

textTemplates.name: describe_request_complete
textTemplates.text: ✅ Request completed at {!$Flow.CurrentDateTime}.

textTemplates.name: describe_request_initiated
textTemplates.text: Agent {!$Record.Agent_Name__c} ({!$Record.Agent_Email__c}) initiated release from {!$Record.Releasing_Broker_Name__c} ({!$Record.Releasing_Broker_Email__c}) at {!$Record.CreatedDate}. Agent is at Step 1.

textTemplates.description: This e-mail is sent to the agent to ensure they have access to the e-mail address on file.
textTemplates.name: email_agent_email_verification
textTemplates.text:
You are receiving this email because you have initiated a request using the Express Change Broker Request through your MyPVL account. If you initiated this request, please verify your email address by clicking the link below.

Verify Email Address

If you did not request this change, please contact the Real Estate Branch at 808-586-2643 for assistance.

{!email_footer}

textTemplates.name: email_awaiting_hire
textTemplates.text:
Thank you! Your new broker has received your request.

We are now awaiting their response. Your new hiring broker must approve your request within 10 days; otherwise, your license will be automatically placed on inactive status. We recommend contacting your selected broker to inform them that you have initiated a request using the 'Express Change Broker Form.’

IMPORTANT! Should you need to reactivate your license, you must submit a hardcopy change form. Use the link below to download the form.

Download Change Form - Real Estate

We appreciate your patience as we continue to process your request!

{!email_footer}

textTemplates.name: email_awaiting_hire_slow
textTemplates.text:
Aloha {!$Record.Agent_Name__c},

Your hiring broker was sent an email on {!$Record.Agent_Submitted_Request_Date__c}, however your new hiring broker has not yet responded to your request to be hired.

You may wish to contact your hiring broker to remind them of your request. If they fail to respond, your license will be inactivated, and you must complete a hard copy Change Form- Real Estate and pay a $25 fee to reactivate your license.

{!email_footer}

textTemplates.name: email_awaiting_release
textTemplates.text:
Aloha {!$Record.Agent_Name__c},

You initiated a request to be released on {!$Record.Agent_Submitted_Request_Date__c}, however your releasing broker has not yet responded.

You may wish to contact your releasing broker to remind them of your request OR after 10 days you will be automatically released, and an email can then be forwarded to your Hiring Broker.

{!email_footer}

textTemplates.name: email_confirm_hire
textTemplates.text:
You are receiving this email because {!$Record.Agent_Name__c} has requested to join your brokerage. To complete this request, please click the appropriate button below to confirm your decision.

If you have any questions regarding this request, please contact the licensee.

Confirm  Deny

WARNING: You must comply with this request within 10 days, as required by HAR § 16-99-5. Failure to do so may result in disciplinary action.

{!email_footer}

textTemplates.name: email_confirm_hire_slow
textTemplates.text:
You are receiving this email because {!$Record.Agent_Name__c} has sent you a request to be hired on {!$Record.Agent_Submitted_Request_Date__c}, however, you have not yet confirmed their hiring. You may use the link below to confirm the hire.

As a reminder, you must respond to this request within 10 days as required by HAR § 16-99-5. Failure to comply may result in disciplinary action.

Confirm  Deny

{!email_footer}

textTemplates.name: email_confirm_release
textTemplates.text:
You are receiving this email because {!$Record.Agent_Name__c} has initiated a Change Broker request, as you are the broker on file with the Professional and Vocational Licensing Division. To complete this request, you will need to click the link below to confirm the release of {!$Record.Agent_Name__c}.

If you have any questions, please contact the Licensee initiating this request.

Confirm Release

WARNING: You must comply with this request within 10 days as required by HAR § 16-99-5. Failure to comply may result in disciplinary action.

{!email_footer}

textTemplates.name: email_confirm_release_slow
textTemplates.text:
You are receiving this email because {!$Record.Agent_Name__c} has initiated Change Broker request to be released from your employment on {!$Record.Agent_Submitted_Request_Date__c}, however, you have not yet confirmed the release. You may use the link below to confirm release.

As a reminder, you must respond to this request within 10 days as required by HAR § 16-99-5. Failure to comply may result in disciplinary action.

Confirm Release

{!email_footer}

textTemplates.name: email_email_bounced
textTemplates.text:
Aloha {!$Record.Agent_Name__c},

This email is to inform you that an e-mail to one of the brokers on file could not be sent. As a result, your request has been automatically canceled. To update your license, you must submit a hard copy Change Form – Real Estate. {!email_footer}

textTemplates.name: email_footer
textTemplates.text:
Mahalo,
Real Estate Branch
Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs
808-586-2643

textTemplates.name: email_forced_release
textTemplates.text:
This email is to inform you that {!$Record.Agent_Name__c} has been administratively released from your brokerage since you did not respond within the 10 days as required by HAR § 16-99-5.

{!email_footer}

textTemplates.name: email_new_broker_denied_receipt
textTemplates.text:
Aloha,

This email is to inform you that you have denied {!$Record.Agent_Name__c}'s request to join your brokerage. Therefore, {!$Record.Agent_Name__c} has been placed on an inactive status and is not associated with your brokerage. The Licensee is now required to submit a hard copy Change Form – Real Estate.

{!email_footer}

textTemplates.name: email_new_broker_did_not_respond
textTemplates.text:
Aloha {!$Record.Agent_Name__c},

This email is to inform you that the hiring broker you selected has not responded to your request to join their brokerage within the 10 days as required by HAR §16-99-5. Therefore, your license has been placed on an inactive status, and you are NOT associated with any brokerage.

To reactivate your license, you must submit a hard copy Change Form – Real Estate. {!email_footer}

textTemplates.name: email_new_broker_failed
textTemplates.text:
Aloha {!$Record.Agent_Name__c},

This email is to inform you that the hiring broker {!$Record.New_Broker_Name__c} denied your request to join their brokerage. Therefore, your license has been placed on an inactive status, and you are NOT associated with any brokerage.

To reactivate your license, you must submit a hard copy Change Form – Real Estate. {!email_footer}

textTemplates.name: email_new_broker_forced_receipt
textTemplates.text:
Aloha,

This email is to inform you that you have not responded to {!$Record.Agent_Name__c}’s request to join your brokerage within the 10 days as required by HAR §16-99-5. Therefore, {!$Record.Agent_Name__c} has been placed on an inactive status and is not associated with your brokerage. The Licensee is now required to submit a hard copy Change Form – Real Estate.

{!email_footer}

textTemplates.name: email_new_broker_receipt
textTemplates.text:
Aloha,

This email confirms the hiring of {!$Record.Agent_Name__c}. This Licensee is now associated with your brokerage.

{!email_footer}

textTemplates.name: email_release_complete
textTemplates.text:
You’ve officially been released from {!$Record.Releasing_Brokerage_Name__c} by {!$Record.Releasing_Broker_Name__c}.

We will now proceed with obtaining confirmation from the new hiring broker to finalize the hiring process.

In the meantime, you shall not engage in any Real Estate activities with your new hiring broker until you receive official confirmation that this change request has been completed.

{!email_footer}

textTemplates.name: email_releasing_broker_receipt
textTemplates.text:
This email confirms your release of {!$Record.Agent_Name__c}. This Licensee is no longer associated with your brokerage.

{!email_footer}

textTemplates.name: email_request_complete
textTemplates.text:
Aloha {!$Record.Agent_Name__c},

Your Express Change Broker request has been successfully completed. You are now officially affiliated with {!$Record.New_Brokerage_Name__c}. This email serves as your official notification of the change.

You may log into your MyPVL account to review your updated license details and change history.

Wishing you continued success!

{!email_footer}
